scenes.name: खाटू श्याम जी
scenes.subtitle: श्री श्याम दरबार में दर्शन
scenes.scene: A grand temple sanctum. The divine figure from IMAGE 2 is enthroned on a decorated altar on the left, surrounded by marigold and rose garlands, brass oil lamps, and soft golden light rays falling from above. Warm devotional atmosphere, incense haze in the air.
scenes.pose: Place the visitor from IMAGE 1 standing on the right side of the frame, in front of and slightly below the altar, turned three-quarters toward the divine figure. Their palms are pressed together at chest height in a namaskar / folded-hands gesture, head bowed slightly, eyes lowered in reverence. Their expression is calm and devotional. Both figures are fully visible in one frame.
scenes.mood: Warm golden-hour devotional lighting, rich saturated temple colours, shallow depth of field, shot like a respectful professional temple photograph.

scenes.name: भगवान महावीर
scenes.subtitle: महावीर स्वामी के चरणों में
scenes.scene: A serene white marble Jain temple interior. The figure from IMAGE 2 is seated in meditation on a raised marble pedestal on the left, framed by intricately carved arches, with soft diffused daylight and a calm minimal palette of white, cream and pale gold.
scenes.pose: Place the visitor from IMAGE 1 on the right, standing a respectful distance from the pedestal, body turned toward the seated figure, palms joined together at the chest in a namaskar gesture, head gently bowed, peaceful expression. Both figures fully visible in one frame.
scenes.mood: Soft, clean, diffused natural light. Serene and minimal. Low contrast, gentle shadows, tranquil and dignified.

scenes.name: Celebrity Meet
scenes.subtitle: Star ke saath ek yaadgaar photo
scenes.scene: A polished event backdrop - a red carpet step-and-repeat media wall with soft branded panels, bright event spotlights and a subtle blurred crowd with camera flashes in the background.
scenes.pose: Place the visitor from IMAGE 1 standing shoulder-to-shoulder beside the person from IMAGE 2, both facing the camera and smiling naturally, as in a genuine fan meet-and-greet photograph. The person from IMAGE 2 has one arm relaxed around the visitor's shoulder in a friendly pose. Natural, candid, equal footing, both faces clearly visible.
scenes.mood: Bright, crisp event photography with a on-camera flash look, vibrant colours, slight background bokeh, shot at eye level on a 35mm lens.

scenes.name: Brand Mascot
scenes.subtitle: Mascot ke saath selfie
scenes.scene: A bright, colourful exhibition stall with clean branded panels, modern lighting and a lively but softly blurred trade-show background.
scenes.pose: Place the visitor from IMAGE 1 standing next to the character from IMAGE 2, both facing the camera. The visitor is smiling and giving a thumbs-up; the character stands beside them in a cheerful, welcoming pose. Both fully visible.
scenes.mood: Bright, high-key, cheerful commercial photography. Punchy colours, even lighting, playful and energetic.
